UPGRADE GUIDE

Find your exact laptop model

Locate the machine type and distinguish models with nearly identical names.

Find the machine type

Read the model and machine-type model (MTM) from the label on the laptop or original box. Lenovo also documents finding the model-type number in Windows. Keep the serial number private. Search the Atlas by model or one of the listed four-character machine types.

Match the platform

Compare the exact generation, processor family and machine type with the record. A T14 sticker alone leaves both the generation and processor platform open. On a used device, check the current configuration as well as the original model listing, since parts may have changed.
